stories.title: Laver Cup 2026 Final — Team Europe Wins 13-5, Zverev Clinches

x_posts.text: DONE. Team Europe wins the 2026 #LaverCup 13-5. Zverev clinched it with a 7-6(3), 6-3 win over Tien. Cobolli/Menšík took the doubles opener. Europe reclaim the Cup. Zverev's 4th career clinch. 🎾

stories.title: Singapore Open Final — Fernandez Claims Sixth Title, Beats Gibson

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: Leylah Fernandez wins the Singapore Open 7-5, 6-0 over Talia Gibson. Her 6th career WTA title, 2nd at the 500 level. A dominant performance to close out a wild, drama-filled week in Singapore. 🎾 #WTASingapore

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: What a week it was in Singapore. Gibson went from unseeded qualifier → Sakkari upset → final via walkover controversy. She got to the final. Fernandez just had better answers. Congrats to both. #WTASingapore
